Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, O Witness of every secret conversation
And the place of every complaint
And Knower of every hidden thing
And the final destination of every need
O Initiator of blessings upon Your servants
O Generous in forgiveness
O Best in overlooking
O Most Generous

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ لَايُوَارِيْ مِنْهُ لَيْلٌ دَاجٍ
Translation: O One from whom the dark night cannot conceal
Nor the tumultuous sea
Nor the sky with its constellations
Nor the darkness with its layers
O One for whom darkness is light
I ask You by the light of Your noble face

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْ تَجَلَّيْتَ بِهِ لِلْجَبَلِ فَجَعَلْتَهُ دَكًّا
Translation: With which You manifested to the mountain, turning it to dust
And Moses fell down unconscious

Arabic text: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ رَفَعْتَ بِهِ السَّمَاوَاتِ بِلَا عَمَدٍ
Translation: And by Your name with which You raised the heavens without pillars

Arabic text: وَسَطَحْتَ بِهِ الْأَرْضَ عَلَى وَجْهِ مَاءٍ جَمَدٍ
Translation: And spread the earth upon the surface of frozen water
And by Your name that is hidden and concealed
The written and the pure
Which when You are called by it, You respond
And when asked by it, You give
And by Your name the Glorified, the Holy, the Proof

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْ هُوَ نُورٌ عَلَى كُلِّ نُورٍ
Translation: Which is light upon all lights
And light from light
From which all light shines
When it reaches the earth, it splits open
And when it reaches the heavens, they open
And when it reaches the Throne, it trembles

Arabic text: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ تَرْتَعِدُ مِنْهُ فَرَائِصُ مَلَائِكَتِكَ
Translation: And by Your name which causes the limbs of Your angels to tremble
And I ask You by the right of Gabriel, Michael, and Israfil
And by the right of Muhammad, the Chosen
May Allah's blessings be upon him and his family
And upon all the prophets and all the angels

Arabic text: وَبِالَاسْمِ الَّذِيْ مَشىٰ بِهِ الْخِضْرُ عَلَى قُلَلِ الْمَاءِ
Translation: And by the name with which Khidr walked upon the crests of water

Arabic text: كَمَا مَشىٰ بِهِ عَلَى جَدَدِ الْأَرْضِ
Translation: As he walked upon the solid ground

Arabic text: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ فَلَقْتَ بِهِ الْبَحْرَ لِمُوسٰى
Translation: And by Your name with which You parted the sea for Moses
And drowned Pharaoh and his people
And saved by it Moses, son of Imran
From the right side of Mount Tur

Arabic text: فَاسْتَجَبْتَ لَهُ وَأَلْقَيْتَ عَلَيْهِ مَحَبَّةً مِنْكَ
Translation: So You answered him and cast upon him love from You

Arabic text: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ بِهِ أَحْيَا عِيسٰى بْنُ مَرْيَمَ الْمَوْتىٰ
Translation: And by Your name with which Jesus, son of Mary, revived the dead
And spoke in the cradle as an infant
And healed the blind and the leper by Your permission

Arabic text: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ دَعَاكَ بِهِ حَمَلَةُ عَرْشِكَ
Translation: And by Your name with which the bearers of Your throne called upon You
And Gabriel, Michael, and Israfil

Arabic text: وَحَبِيبُكَ مُحَمَّدٌ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: And Your beloved Muhammad, may Allah bless him and his family
And Your angels who are close to You
And Your messengers among the prophets

Arabic text: وَعِبَادُكَ الصَّالِحُونَ مِنْ أَهْلِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرَضِينَ
Translation: And Your righteous servants from the people of the heavens and earths

Arabic text: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ دَعَاكَ بِهِ ذُوْ النُّونِ
Translation: And by Your name with which Dhun-Nun (Jonah) called upon You

Arabic text: إِذْ ذَهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا فَظَنَّ أَنْ لَنْ تَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: When he went away in anger and thought We had no power over him

Arabic text: فَنَادىٰ فِيْ الظُّلُمَاتِ أَنْ لاَإِلٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ
Translation: Then he cried through the darkness: "There is no god but You, Glory be to You
Indeed, I have been among the wrongdoers"
So You responded to him and saved him from distress
And thus do You save the believers

Arabic text: وَبِاسْمِكَ الْعَظِيمِ الَّذِيْ دَعَاكَ بِهِ دَاوُدُ
Translation: And by Your great name with which David called upon You

Arabic text: وَخَرَّ لَكَ سَاجِدًا فَغَفَرْتَ لَهُ ذَنْبَهُ
Translation: And fell prostrating before You, so You forgave his sin

Arabic text: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ دَعَتْكَ بِهِ آسِيَةُ امْرَأَةُ فِرْعَوْنَ
Translation: And by Your name with which Asiya, the wife of Pharaoh, called upon You

Arabic text: إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ابْنِ لِيْ عِنْدَكَ بَيْتًا فِيْ الْجَنَّةِ
Translation: When she said: "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise
And save me from Pharaoh and his deeds
And save me from the wrongdoing people"
So You answered her prayer

Arabic text: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ دَعَاكَ بِهِ أَيُّوبُ إِذْ حَلَّ بِهِ الْبَلاءُ
Translation: And by Your name with which Job called upon You when affliction befell him

Arabic text: فَعَافَيْتَهُ وَ آتَيْتَهُ أَهْلَهُ وَمِثْلَهُمْ مَعَهُمْ
Translation: So You healed him and restored to him his family and the like thereof with them
As a mercy from You and a reminder for the worshippers
And by Your name with which Jacob called upon You

Arabic text: فَرَدَدْتَ عَلَيْهِ بَصَرَهُ وَقُرَّةَ عَيْنِهِ يُوسُفَ وَجَمَعْتَ شَمْلَهُ
Translation: So You restored to him his sight and the joy of his eyes, Joseph, and reunited his family
And by Your name with which Solomon called upon You

Arabic text: فَوَهَبْتَ لَهُ مُلْكًا لَا يَنْبَغِيْ لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ
Translation: So You granted him a kingdom not suited to anyone after him
Indeed, You are the Bestower

Arabic text: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ سَخَّرْتَ بِهِ الْبُرَاقَ لِمُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: And by Your name with which You subjected the Buraq for Muhammad

Arabic text: صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ
Translation: May Allah bless him and his family and grant them peace

Arabic text: إِذْ قَالَ تَعَالَى سُبْحٰانَ الَّذِيْ أَسْرىٰ بِعَبْدِهِ لَيْلًا
Translation: When the Most High said: "Glory to Him Who took His servant by night

Arabic text: مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ إِلَى الْمَسْجِدِ الْأَقْصىٰ
Translation: From the Sacred Mosque to the Farthest Mosque"

Arabic text: وَقَوْلُهُ سُبْحٰانَ الَّذِيْ سَخَّرَ لَنَا هٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِيْنَ
Translation: And His saying: "Glory to Him Who has subjected this to us, and we could not have done it ourselves
And indeed to our Lord we will return"

Arabic text: وَبِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ تَنَزَّلَ بِهِ جَبْرَئِيلُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: And by Your name with which Gabriel descended upon Muhammad
May Allah bless him and his family
And by Your name with which Adam called upon You
So You forgave his sin and settled him in Your Paradise
And I ask You by the right of the Great Quran
And by the right of Muhammad, the Seal of the Prophets
And by the right of Abraham
And by the right of Your judgment on the Day of Reckoning
And by the right of the scales when they are set up
And the scrolls when they are spread out
And by the right of the Pen and what it has written
And the Tablet and what it has enumerated

Arabic text: وَبِحَقِّ الْإِسْمِ الَّذِيْ كَتَبْتَهُ عَلَى سُرَادِقِ الْعَرْشِ
Translation: And by the right of the Name which You wrote on the veil of the Throne
Before You created the creation and the world
And the sun and the moon by two thousand years

Arabic text: وَأَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ
Translation: And I bear witness that there is no god but Allah
Alone with no partner
And that Muhammad is His servant and messenger
And I ask You by Your name that is hidden in Your treasuries

Arabic text: اَلَّذِيْ اسْتَأْثَرْتَ بِهِ فِيْ عِلْمِ الْغَيْبِ عِنْدَكَ
Translation: Which You have kept exclusively in Your knowledge of the unseen

Arabic text: لَمْ يَظْهَرْ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
Translation: No one from Your creation has seen it
Not any close angel
Nor any sent prophet
Nor any chosen servant

Arabic text: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ شَقَقْتَ بِهِ الْبِحَارَ
Translation: And I ask You by Your name with which You split the seas
And by which the mountains stand
And by which the night and day alternate
And by the right of the Seven Oft-repeated verses and the Great Quran
And by the right of the noble recording angels

Arabic text: وَبِحَقِّ طٰهٰ وَ يٰس وَ كهٰيٰعص
Translation: And by the right of Ta Ha, Ya Sin, Kaf Ha Ya Ayn Sad
And Ha Mim Ayn Sin Qaf
And by the right of the Torah of Moses
And the Gospel of Jesus
And the Psalms of David
And the Criterion (Quran) of Muhammad
May Allah bless him and his family
And upon all the messengers and by Bahiyyan Sharahiyyan

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ تِلْكَ الْمُنَاجَاةِ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You by the right of those private conversations

Arabic text: اَلَّتِيْ كَانَتْ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ مُوسٰى بْنِ عِمْرَانَ
Translation: That were between You and Moses, son of Imran
Above Mount Tur Sinai

Arabic text: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ عَلَّمْتَهُ مَلَكَ الْمَوْتِ لِقَبْضِ الْأَرْوَاحِ
Translation: And I ask You by Your name which You taught the Angel of Death for taking souls

Arabic text: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ كُتِبَ عَلَى وَرَقِ الزَّيْتُونِ
Translation: And I ask You by Your name which was written on the olive leaf
So the fires submitted to that leaf

Arabic text: فَقُلْتَ يَا نَارُ كُونِيْ بَرْدًا وَسَلامًا
Translation: When You said: "O fire, be coolness and peace"

Arabic text: وَأَسْأَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ كَتَبْتَهُ عَلَى سُرَادِقِ الْمَجْدِ وَالْكَرَامَةِ
Translation: And I ask You by Your name which You wrote on the veil of glory and honor
O One whom no questioner can exhaust
And no receiver can diminish

Arabic text: يَا مَنْ بِهِ يُسْتَغَاثُ وَإِلَيْهِ يُلْجَأُ
Translation: O One from whom help is sought and to whom refuge is taken
I ask You by the places of honor on Your throne
And the utmost of mercy from Your Book
And by Your Greatest Name
And Your Highest Majesty
And Your Perfect Exalted Words
O Allah, Lord of the winds and what they scatter
And the sky and what it shades
And the earth and what it carries
And the devils and whom they misguide
And the seas and what flows in them

Arabic text: وَبِحَقِّ كُلِّ حَقٍّ هُوَ عَلَيْكَ حَقٌّ
Translation: And by the right of every right that is upon You
And by the right of the angels who are close
And the spiritual ones and the cherubim

Arabic text: وَالْمُسَبِّحِيْنَ لَكَ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ
Translation: And those who glorify You by night and day without tiring
And by the right of Abraham, Your friend

Arabic text: وَبِحَقِّ كُلِّ وَلِيٍّ يُنَادِيْكَ بَيْنَ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةِ
Translation: And by the right of every saint who calls upon You between Safa and Marwa
And You answer their prayer

Arabic text: يَا مُجِيبُ أَسْأَلُكَ بِحَقِّ هٰذِهِ الْأَسْمَاءِ وَبِهٰذِهِ الدَّعَوَاتِ
Translation: O Responsive One, I ask You by the right of these names and by these supplications

Arabic text: أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَنَا مَا قَدَّمْنَا وَمَا أَخَّرْنَا
Translation: That You forgive us what we have done and what we will do
And what we have concealed and what we have revealed
And what we have shown and what we have hidden
And what You know better about us than we do
Indeed, You have power over all things
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful
O Protector of every stranger
O Companion of every lonely one
O Strength of every weak one
O Helper of every oppressed one
O Provider for every deprived one
O Comforter of every frightened one
O Companion of every traveler
O Support of everyone present
O Forgiver of every sin and mistake
O Relief of those who seek relief
O Helper of those who cry for help
O Remover of the distress of the distressed
O Reliever of the anxiety of the anxious
O Creator of the heavens and earths
O Ultimate Goal of those who seek
O Answerer of the prayers of the desperate
O Most Merciful of the merciful
O Lord of the worlds
O Judge of the Day of Judgment
O Most Generous of the generous
O Most Honorable of the honorable
O Most Hearing of those who hear
O Most Seeing of those who see
O Most Capable of those who are capable

Arabic text: اِغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِيْ تُغَيِّرُ النِّعَمَ
Translation: Forgive me the sins that alter blessings

Arabic text: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِيْ تُورِثُ النَّدَمَ
Translation: And forgive me the sins that bring regret

Arabic text: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِيْ تُورِثُ السَّقَمَ
Translation: And forgive me the sins that cause illness

Arabic text: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِيْ تَهْتِكُ الْعِصَمَ
Translation: And forgive me the sins that tear apart protection

Arabic text: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِيْ تَرُدُّ الدُّعَاءَ
Translation: And forgive me the sins that reject prayers

Arabic text: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِيْ تَحْبِسُ قَطْرَ السَّمَاءِ
Translation: And forgive me the sins that withhold the rain from the sky

Arabic text: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِيْ تُعَجِّلُ الْفَنَاءَ
Translation: And forgive me the sins that hasten destruction

Arabic text: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِيْ تَجْلِبُ الشَّقَاءَ
Translation: And forgive me the sins that bring misery

Arabic text: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِيْ تُظْلِمُ الْهَوَاءَ
Translation: And forgive me the sins that darken the air

Arabic text: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِيْ تَكْشِفُ الْغِطَاءَ
Translation: And forgive me the sins that remove the veil

Arabic text: وَاغْفِرْ لِيَ الذُّنُوبَ الَّتِيْ لَا يَغْفِرُهَا غَيْرُكَ يَا اَللَّهُ
Translation: And forgive me the sins that none can forgive except You, O Allah

Arabic text: وَاحْمِلْ عَنِّيْ كُلَّ تَبِعَةٍ لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ
Translation: And remove from me every consequence owed to any of Your creation

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ لِيْ مِنْ أَمْرِيْ فَرَجًا وَمَخْرَجًا وَيُسْرًا
Translation: And make for me from my affairs relief, a way out, and ease
And place Your certainty in my chest

Arabic text: وَرَجَاءَكَ فِيْ قَلْبِيْ حَتّىٰ لَا أَرْجُوَ غَيْرَكَ
Translation: And Your hope in my heart until I hope for none but You
O Allah, protect me and grant me well-being in my position
And accompany me in my night and day
And from before me and behind me
And from my right and my left
And from above me and below me
And make easy for me the path
And grant me the best facilitation
And do not forsake me in difficulty
And guide me, O Best of guides

Arabic text: وَلَا تَكِلْنِيْ إِلٰى نَفْسِيْ فِيْ الْأُمُورِ
Translation: And do not leave me to myself in my affairs
And grant me every happiness
And return me to my family with success and prosperity
Blessed in the immediate and the future
Indeed, You have power over all things
And provide for me from Your bounty
And expand for me from the goodness of Your provision
And employ me in Your obedience
And protect me from Your punishment and Your fire

Arabic text: وَاقْلِبْنِيْ إِذَا تَوَفَّيْتَنِيْ إِلٰى جَنَّتِكَ بِرَحْمَتِكَ
Translation: And when You take my soul, lead me to Your Paradise by Your mercy

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ
Translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the removal of Your blessing
And from the change of Your well-being
And from the coming of Your vengeance
And from the descent of Your punishment
And I seek refuge in You from the hardship of affliction
And the attainment of misery
And from evil destiny
And the gloating of enemies

Arabic text: وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ
Translation: And from the evil of what descends from the sky

Arabic text: وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيْ الْكِتَابِ الْمُنْزَلِ
Translation: And from the evil of what is in the revealed Book
O Allah, do not make me among the evil ones
Nor among the companions of the Fire
And do not deprive me of the companionship of the good
And give me a good life
And a good death that joins me with the righteous
And grant me the companionship of the prophets

Arabic text: فِيْ مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِنْدَ مَلِيكٍ مُقْتَدِرٍ
Translation: In a seat of truth with a Sovereign, Perfect in ability

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى حُسْنِ بَلائِكَ وَصُنْعِكَ
Translation: O Allah, to You is praise for Your good trial and Your making

Arabic text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى الْإِسْلاَمِ وَاتِّبَاعِ السُّنَّةِ
Translation: And to You is praise for Islam and following the Sunnah
O Lord, as You guided them to Your religion
And taught them Your Book, so guide us and teach us

Arabic text: وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى حُسْنِ بَلائِكَ وَصُنْعِكَ عِنْدِيْ خَاصَّةً
Translation: And to You is praise for Your good trial and Your making, especially with me
As You created me and perfected my creation
And taught me and perfected my education
And guided me and perfected my guidance

Arabic text: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى إِنْعَامِكَ عَلَيَّ قَدِيمًا وَحَدِيثًا
Translation: So to You is praise for Your favors upon me, past and present

Arabic text: فَكَمْ مِنْ كَرْبٍ يَا سَيِّدِيْ قَدْ فَرَّجْتَهُ
Translation: How many distresses, O my Master, have You relieved

Arabic text: وَكَمْ مِنْ غَمٍّ يَا سَيِّدِيْ قَدْ نَفَّسْتَهُ
Translation: And how many sorrows, O my Master, have You dispelled

Arabic text: وَكَمْ مِنْ هَمٍّ يَا سَيِّدِيْ قَدْ كَشَفْتَهُ
Translation: And how many anxieties, O my Master, have You removed

Arabic text: وَكَمْ مِنْ بَلاءٍ يَا سَيِّدِيْ قَدْ صَرَفْتَهُ
Translation: And how many afflictions, O my Master, have You averted

Arabic text: وَكَمْ مِنْ عَيْبٍ يَا سَيِّدِيْ قَدْ سَتَرْتَهُ
Translation: And how many faults, O my Master, have You concealed
So to You is praise in every condition
In every dwelling and time
And transition and station
And in this state and every state

Arabic text: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِيْ مِنْ أَفْضَلِ عِبَادِكَ نَصِيبًا
Translation: O Allah, make me among the most favored of Your servants in share

Arabic text: فِيْ هٰذَا الْيَوْمِ مِنْ خَيْرٍ تَقْسِمُهُ
Translation: On this day of any good You distribute
Or harm You remove
Or evil You avert
Or affliction You repel
Or good You drive
Or mercy You spread
Or well-being You clothe
For You have power over all things
And in Your hand are the treasuries of the heavens and earth
And You are the One, the Generous, the Giver
Whose seeker is not rejected
And whose hoper is not disappointed
And whose gifts do not diminish
And what He has does not deplete
Rather, it increases in abundance and goodness
And giving and generosity

Arabic text: وَارْزُقْنِيْ مِنْ خَزَائِنِكَ الَّتِيْ لَا تَفْنىٰ
Translation: And provide me from Your treasuries that do not perish
And from Your vast mercy
Indeed, Your giving has never been restricted
And You have power over all things
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful
